pokedexEntries.ru: Nicknamed “the bully of the sea,” SHARPEDO is widely feared. Its cruel fangs grow back immediately if they snap off. Just one of these POKéMON can thoroughly tear apart a supertanker.

pokedexEntries.sa: SHARPEDO can swim at speeds of up to 75 mph by jetting seawater out of its backside. This POKéMON’s drawback is its inability to swim long distances.

pokedexEntries.frlg: The ruffian of the seas, it has fangs that crunch through iron. It swims by jetting water from its rear.

pokedexEntries.em: The vicious and sly gangster of the sea. Its skin is specially textured to minimize drag in water. Its speed tops out at over 75 miles per hour.

pokedexEntries.dpp: Its fangs rip through sheet iron. It swims at 75 mph and is known as “The Bully of the Sea.”

pokedexEntries.hgss: It can swim at speeds of 75 mph by jetting seawater through its body. It is the bandit of the sea.

pokedexEntries.bw: Its fangs rip through sheet iron. It swims at 75 mph and is known as “The Bully of the Sea.”

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Its fangs rip through sheet iron. It swims at 75 mph and is known as “The Bully of the Sea.”

pokedexEntries.x: Its fangs rip through sheet iron. It swims at 75 mph and is known as “The Bully of the Sea.”

pokedexEntries.y: It can swim at speeds of 75 mph by jetting seawater through its body. It is the bandit of the sea.

pokedexEntries.or: Nicknamed “the bully of the sea,” Sharpedo is widely feared. Its cruel fangs grow back immediately if they snap off. Just one of these Pokémon can thoroughly tear apart a supertanker.

pokedexEntries.as: Sharpedo can swim at speeds of up to 75 mph by jetting seawater out of its backside. This Pokémon’s drawback is its inability to swim long distances.

pokedexEntries.su: It pursues its prey at speeds of 75 mph and finishes them off with fangs that can crush iron. It is known as the bully of the sea.

pokedexEntries.mo: It has a sad history. In the past, its dorsal fin was a treasured foodstuff, so this Pokémon became a victim of overfishing.

pokedexEntries.us: People believe that carrying one of its discarded fangs will prevent mishaps at sea, so the fangs are made into accessories.

pokedexEntries.um: It drinks in seawater and jets it from its rear to propel itself. It’s very sensitive to the scent of blood.

pokedexEntries.sw: As soon as it catches the scent of prey, Sharpedo will jet seawater from its backside, hurtling toward the target to attack at 75 mph.

pokedexEntries.sh: This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sea. Any ship entering the waters Sharpedo calls home will be attacked—no exceptions.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: Its fangs rip through sheet iron. It swims at 75 mph and is known as the Bully of the Sea.
